source: Fictional scout group leaders' meeting (Swedish) written for Task Q (scripts/notes-eval.ts). Fictional scout group and people; no real meeting.
traps: Summer camp preliminarily booked week 28, moved to week 30 before it is decided.
Camp fee first calculated as 1 800 kr, decided as 1 500 kr with 200 kr sibling discount.
Erik 'kan nog höra med matbutiken' about sponsoring, 'räkna inte med det' (not an action).
Noor offers to book the bus, Lisa takes it (final owner Lisa); Noor takes the invitation instead.
Noor types the invitation action into the notes tab herself while saying so (from 04:36); it must not be duplicated, even when the chair repeats it in the summary.
New tents are tabled to the next meeting (allowed only as a deferral). Lisa checking the old tents IS an action.
Numbers in words (femtonhundra, vecka trettio, sista mars).
